criteria_results.title: Memo references ICE Case No. KCS-2024-IF-00482
criteria_results.reasoning: Header and Part III cite ICE HSI Case No. KCS-2024-IF-00482.

criteria_results.title: Memo identifies Hawthorne Precision Manufacturing, Inc. as the respondent
criteria_results.reasoning: Hawthorne Precision Manufacturing, Inc. is identified as the client and respondent.

criteria_results.title: Memo organized by severity with critical issues first
criteria_results.reasoning: The Bottom Line lists the grounds 'in order of significance', with the arithmetic error first, and the body follows the same priority.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies arithmetic discrepancy — $613,470 vs. $165,268
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the $613,470 stated total against the $165,268 sum, a $448,202 discrepancy.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: States the correct sum of schedule subtotals as ~$165,268
ISSUE_001: Recommends challenge or reissuance for arithmetic error
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends a letter to ICE asking for a corrected computation, and pleading the discrepancy as a defense.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies wrong penalty rate table applied
criteria_results.reasoning: Argues the rates exceed the statutory maxima and the citation is a placeholder, but never says the rates in effect when the NOI was served (the January 2023 table) should apply.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies Tier 2 rate overcharge
criteria_results.reasoning: Never identifies $4,727 as the correct Tier 2 rate and does not calculate the ~$3,179 overcharge.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies Category C knowing-employment rate overcharge
criteria_results.reasoning: Never identifies $6,476 as the correct knowing-employment rate and does not calculate the ~$4,592 overcharge.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: States total overcalculation from wrong rate table is ~$7,771
criteria_results.reasoning: Does not quantify a ~$7,771 overcalculation from the wrong rate table.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies James Coldwater should not be fined (retention expired)
criteria_results.reasoning: Shows Coldwater's retention obligation expired 9/30/2021 (later of 6/20/2007 or 9/30/2021), before the NOI, and recommends withdrawing the count.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Calculates corrected Category B penalty as ~$12,535
criteria_results.reasoning: Scenario 3 removes Coldwater and shows Category B at 5 counts x $2,507 = $12,535.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies Carlos Reyes-Montoya reverification error
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 1 attests U.S. citizenship, no EAD was presented, and citizens are never reverified.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Recommends removing Reyes-Montoya violation entirely
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends withdrawing the Reyes-Montoya count.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies improper start date for 10-business-day resolution period
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes ICE counted from March 8, while counting from receipt on March 12 (per USPS tracking) runs the period to March 26.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Notes March 22 response was timely from receipt date
criteria_results.reasoning: States the March 22 response was timely under any computation, including from the March 12 receipt.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Explains impact on constructive knowledge theory
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains that the mis-computed deadline defeats the stated basis for all seven Category C counts.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies Luis Cabrera presented valid documents
criteria_results.reasoning: Cabrera presented a new unexpired EAD (Exh. C-1) and an updated Section 3; recommends withdrawal.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies Anh Tran presented valid documents
criteria_results.reasoning: Tran's I-797 H-1B approval (Exh. D-1) and corrected I-9 were submitted; recommends withdrawal.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Notes NIF Attachment D fails to acknowledge submissions
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes ICE ignored the record, saying employees 'could not provide' documents that were in fact enclosed with the March 22 response.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies Anh Tran holds valid H-1B status
criteria_results.reasoning: Tran holds H-1B status through 9/30/2025 on an approved I-797; the A-Number error was a transposition, so DHS records establish authorization.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies incorrect employee count (500 vs. 347)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies ~500 against 347 actual employees and ties the error to the size-of-business factor.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Notes impact on penalty calculation or mitigation weight
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains that the overstated headcount skews the size factor and the deficiency-rate analysis in Attachment E.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies NIF's 'no good faith' finding is contradicted by specific record facts
criteria_results.reasoning: Counters the good-faith finding with 98.27% production (341/347), production within the 3-day deadline, full cooperation, and no prior violations.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Cites OCAHO precedent or legal standard for good faith mitigation
criteria_results.reasoning: Relies on the 8 U.S.C. 1324a(e)(5) factors and OCAHO's standard that the number of violations alone does not show bad faith.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Challenges Tier 2 classification for first-time audit
criteria_results.reasoning: Challenges Tier 2 as an invented enhancement, citing ICE's concession that it is not a second-offense finding and the clean first-offense history.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Calculates potential savings from Tier 2 reclassification
criteria_results.reasoning: Does not explicitly quantify savings from moving the 11 Tier 2 counts to Tier 1 (e.g., $27,599 or $24,420); the scenarios only fold this in implicitly.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies NIF misstates the 30-day response deadline
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes the NIF runs 30 days from June 12, while from the June 17 service date the deadline is July 17.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Examines Priya Shankar preparer/translator attestation issue
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses preparer completion of Shankar's Section 1 in general, but never notes that the preparer/translator attestation was unsigned per the audit summary, and does not tie the issue to Bledsoe in that analysis.

criteria_results.title: Memo includes estimated total penalty reduction if all challenges succeed
criteria_results.reasoning: The penalty exposure scenarios estimate the aggregate reduction from $613,470 down to about $3,653.

criteria_results.title: Memo recommends requesting OCAHO hearing or preserving hearing rights
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends requesting an OCAHO hearing today.

criteria_results.title: Memo correctly identifies the actual hearing request deadline as July 17, 2024
criteria_results.reasoning: Treats July 12, 2024 as the controlling deadline and says not to rely on July 17.

criteria_results.title: Memo references correct statutory provision for I-9 penalties: 8 USC § 1324a
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites 8 U.S.C. 1324a throughout.

criteria_results.title: Memo discusses at least three of the five statutory penalty factors under 8 USC § 1324a(e)(5)
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses all five statutory factors in Part VIII.

criteria_results.title: Memo notes Hawthorne has no prior ICE violations (clean history)
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes this was the first NOI ever with no prior violations, and argues the clean history deserves mitigating weight.

criteria_results.title: Memo notes the NIF's workforce percentage calculation is wrong
criteria_results.reasoning: Addresses the denominator only for the paperwork deficiency rate, not the unauthorized-worker percentage (1.4% against 2.02%).

criteria_results.title: Memo cites the USPS tracking records as evidence for delivery dates
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites the USPS tracking records for the March 12 and June 17 delivery dates.

criteria_results.title: Memo cites the Braddock & Lyle March 22 response letter as evidence
criteria_results.reasoning: Relies on the Braddock & Lyle March 22 response, including Cabrera's and Tran's exhibits.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Calculates impact of removing Reyes-Montoya on Tier 2 count
criteria_results.reasoning: Does not separately quantify the effect of removing Reyes-Montoya (Tier 2 count from 11 to 10, or the $5,016/$4,727 saving).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006/007: Calculates Category C reduction from removing employees
criteria_results.reasoning: Scenario 3 removes all Category C counts, including Cabrera and Tran, taking that category from $49,924 to $0.

criteria_results.title: Memo references the NOI date (November 14, 2023) as relevant to penalty rate
criteria_results.reasoning: Mentions the November 14, 2023 NOI but never connects that date to which penalty rates apply.
